# eurodns_zone (Data Source)

All DNS records of a EuroDNS zone (URL and mail forwards excluded).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "eurodns_zone" "example" {
  zone = "example.com"
}

output "record_count" {
  value = length(data.eurodns_zone.example.records)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone` (String) Zone name, for example `example.com`.

### Read-Only

- `records` (Attributes List) Records sorted by host, type and rdata. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `host` (String) Host relative to the zone, `@` for the apex.
- `id` (Number) EuroDNS record id.
- `locked` (Boolean) Locked by EuroDNS, cannot be changed.
- `rdata` (String)
- `ttl` (Number)
- `type` (String)
